description: This file contains a utility function `makeWakeWordSegments` that processes a transcript and associated word timing data to generate wake word segments, returning an array of WakeWordSegment objects.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of a wake word, including its text, start time, duration, and text range within the transcript.

methods.name: makeWakeWordSegments
methods.description: Creates an array of WakeWordSegment objects from a transcript and a list of words with their timing information.
